gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-work-sans: Big, friendly, almost magnified letters up top. Work Sans follows in a plain sans with a high mean line and open c tips, so the heading gets to shout while the text stays easy underneath.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-archivo: Baloo Da 2 stands tall, its lowercase nearly as high as its capitals and its s terminals set wide. Archivo does the quieter job, with outward-opening curves and a big x-height that keep the text approachable.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-fs-asap: Asap has open arcs for its c and a body height that nearly matches its capitals, which makes text feel sturdy. Baloo Da 2 above it is the louder one, all commanding display swagger.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Baloo Da 2 comes in bold and commanding, with wide s terminals and lowercase that nearly reaches cap height. Be Vietnam Pro follows in a clean sans of uniform strokes and a high mean line, so paragraphs would flow without any fuss.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-fs-epilogue: Chunky, tall-lowercase display letters meet a wiry, curvy body that feels loose and unclamped. Epilogue's single stroke width and short ascender tips give the pair its strongest quality: a heavy top over a light, relaxed text.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-fs-fira-sans: Commanding headline letters, wide at the s. Fira Sans takes over with a larger-than-usual x-height and one stroke weight throughout, so a body size a touch smaller than the heading would still read comfortably.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-fs-merriweather-sans: Baloo Da 2 hits hard, with wide-set s terminals and lowercase that almost reaches the capitals. Merriweather Sans carries on in a sans with sturdy, tall words and an e that opens clearly, so a long passage would feel steady.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-fs-public-sans: Baloo Da 2 is the show-off here, with wide s terminals and lowercase almost as tall as its capitals. Public Sans is the plain sans doing the heavy lifting, hefty and broad-countered.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-fs-ranade: Lowercase that nearly matches its capitals, plus wide-set s terminals, gives Baloo Da 2 its swagger. Ranade sits against it as a sans-serif with slightly shifting weight and far-apart stroke ends, which feels organic next to that bold display punch.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-fs-supreme: Supreme sets a thick, heavy-looking band of text with letters held open rather than curled shut, crisp and direct. Baloo Da 2 above it brings the bold, commanding display voice.
